title: Big cotangent bundles away from the adjoint base locus for resolved codimension-one-free arithmetic complex-ball quotients
author: Benoît Cadorel; Erwan Rousseau; Behrouz Taji
difficulty_reason: The authors must extend the invariant Bergman metric through quotient singularities using the full adapted-cover/fiber-product and ramification-bound construction. Their local determinant growth and explicit orbifold tangent frames then control the mixed cone/cusp singularities, so the authored twisting argument produces a locally bounded negatively curved metric under the original big-line-bundle hypothesis. The generically immersive resolution closing uses that full new local construction to obtain the selected cotangent-bigness outcome; it is not merely the formal consequence of the final cited curvature criterion.
